notes.title: The Mines of Morseph Patch Update v1.1
notes.notes:
I have added a patch that fixes the following:

1) Fixes issue of pause screen looking like tiles are removed from scene

2) Makes game pad input more responsive

3) Introduction loading screen is MUCH faster than before

The game supports fully XInput compatible game pads. This includes rumble. Please let us know (either publicly or privately) if you encounter any issues and I will fix them ASAP.

Sincerely,
Matthew

notes.title: The Mines of Morseph is complete and pending review!
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce that the game is wrapped up and waiting on review. We have updated the previous build to include support for all XInput game controllers and even have support for rumble! We tested on an Xbox 360 for Windows controller and rumble works wonderfully! It adds a nice third sense to the game (visuals and sound being the other two!)

We look forward to releasing this game to you soon!

Love,
Matthew, Tori, and Fawn
Nuts and Volts Electronics Team

notes.title: The Mines of Morseph is near completion!
notes.notes:
We are wrapping up the primary development of the game. We have a few things to add like the Super Boss, the ending, credits, etc. 

We are pleased to announce that we have implemented 12 User Achievements for the game and just implemented a community leaderboard for amount of Gold Pieces!

We will have the game completed far ahead of our October 3rd release date but we want time to tweak, test, and make sure everything is just right for the release. 

We were excited to make this game and we hope you all will be excited to play it.

Thanks all from the Nuts and Volts Electronics team!
Love,
Matthew, Tori, and Fawn
